name: kind-beastcaller-enter-look-five-decline-all-five-bottom
notes: Kind Beastcaller (k02kvfblwa): an Animal ally is available but the player declines the 'may reveal'. All five go to the bottom in their original order and nothing is stranded in the temp zone (the follow-up needed dontSkipOnPass).

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Enter: Look at the top five cards of your deck. You may reveal an Animal or Beast ally card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The generated enterAbilities["k02kvfblwa:0"] body looked at the top five cards with a loop of MZMove($player, "myDeck-0", "myTempZone"): Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so "myDeck-0" re-resolved to the SAME removed slot after the first and MZMove's already-removed guard silently no-oped -- only the top card was ever looked at (an Animal or Beast ally deeper in the deck was never offered). The "may reveal" follow-up CUSTOM was also added without dontSkipOnPass, so declining (PASS) skipped it and stranded the looked-at card in myTempZone. The generated file cannot be edited (gitignored), so the closure and its handler are overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php with MZMoveTopOfZone(), PutTempZoneOnBottomOfDeck() and dontSkipOnPass:1.
